race.comment: FELIX MAJESTIC (2) has been knocking on the door of another victory with three consecutive placings in Saturday metro company and will find this affair more to his liking. Gets some weight off with the 1.5kg claim and should be able to sit up on speed. Definite winning prospects against this line-up. The well-related BARTOLF (4) (half to G3 winner Jal Lei) has a handy record over this distance range with two wins and two seconds from six attempts and gets gun hoop J Mac on board from a low draw. Watch for a spike in form. CAFE AU LAIT (13) will be ready to peak now third run back and looks a must for the multiples. ALABAMA FOX (11) returns from a lay-off. Finished fifth in most recent trial at Randwick. Opened last campaign with a fourth at Randwick Kensington over 1250m. Can give this a shake fresh.
